candidates.description: Whistle speech-to-text running fully on an ESP32-S3: hold a button, say a colour in one of 7 languages, the LED does it. No network.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Whistle speech recognition on an ESP32-S3

Hold a button and say *"flash the light blue"*. The LED flashes blue.

The speech recognition runs entirely on a $10 microcontroller: no network, no
cloud, no phone. It transcribes whatever you say rather than matching a fixed
list of phrases, and it understands commands in seven languages.

The model is [Whistle](https://huggingface.co/Cactus-Compute/whistle) by
Cactus Compute (Apache 2.0). Cactus ships no ESP32 build and no source for
Whistle's engine. Everything here is an independent C99 implementation with no
dependencies, checked tensor by tensor against the official engine.

## What you need

| Part | Notes |
|---|---|
| ESP32-S3 board, **N16R8** | 16 MB flash and 8 MB **octal** PSRAM. The model alone is 14.5 MB. ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8 or a clone. |
| INMP441 I²S microphone module | the common round breakout board |
| Momentary push button | any tactile switch |
| Jumper wires, breadboard | 8 wires |
| USB cable | to the board's native **USB** port |

The RGB LED is the WS2812 that is already on the board.

## Wiring

![Wiring diagram: INMP441 and push button on an ESP32-S3](docs/wiring.svg)

| From | To | |
|---|---|---|
| INMP441 VDD | 3V3 | 3.3 V, not 5 V |
| INMP441 GND | GND | |
| INMP441 L/R | GND | picks the left channel, which the firmware reads |
| INMP441 SCK | GPIO4 | I²S bit clock |
| INMP441 WS | GPIO5 | I²S word select |
| INMP441 SD | GPIO6 | I²S data |
| Button | GPIO7 and GND | the internal pull-up is used, so no resistor |
| WS2812 LED | GPIO48 | on the board already |

Clone boards place header pins differently, so go by the GPIO numbers printed
on your board. If your LED sits on another pin (DevKitC-1 v1.1 uses GPIO38),
change `ONBOARD_GPIO` at the top of `esp32/whistle_demo/main/main.c`. A
[PNG version](docs/wiring.png) of the diagram is there for printing.

**Check the microphone before anything else.** Loose jumper wires are the
most common fault. `esp32/mic_test` records while the button is held, and
`tools/mic_capture.py` saves each clip as a WAV you can listen to. Speech
should sit well above the noise floor (about -45 vs -68 dBFS) with `jumps=0`.
Stretches of an exact bit pattern such as `0xAAAA` mean a bad SCK, WS or power
contact.

## Setup

You need [ESP-IDF](https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/stable/esp32s3/get-started/)
v5.5 or newer, Python 3 and CMake.

candidates.readme_excerpt:
# DBS Soundtrack Separation for ComfyUI

Separate a soundtrack into **music**, **sound effects** and **speech** inside ComfyUI, with the official **Dynamic Band
Splitting (DBS)** models ([JusperLee/Dynamic-Band-Splitting](https://github.com/JusperLee/Dynamic-Band-Splitting),
[paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14993)). Use it to remove the dialogue of a video and keep its music and effects, to pull the
dialogue out for dubbing or transcription, or to rebalance a mix. The models are tiny (1.0M and 4.7M parameters), run on CUDA or
the CPU, and the three stems add back up to the input. The nodes run the vendored official code and never download anything.

> **Unofficial.** This node pack is an independent integration. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the DBS authors or by
> Comfy Org.
>
> 日本語の概要は [README.ja.md](README.ja.md) にあります。

![Spectrograms of a 12 s excerpt of Tears of Steel and of its music, sound-effects and speech stems](docs/images/stems.png)

*Tears of Steel (CC BY 3.0, Blender Foundation), 12 s of the project page's mixture; below it this pack's DBS-TIGER stems (CPU),
which are bit for bit the official package's output for the same file.*

## What it does

| Node | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| **DBS Loader** | Picks the model (DBS-TIGER-DnR or DBS-BSRNN-DnR) and the device (`auto` = ComfyUI's GPU when it is CUDA, else `cpu`) |
| **DBS Separate (music / sfx / speech)** | `AUDIO` in → `music`, `sfx`, `speech` (`AUDIO`) and a JSON report |

Connect ComfyUI's **Load Audio** (or **Load Video** → **Get Video Components**) in front. To remove the dialogue, add `music` and
`sfx` with ComfyUI's **Merge Audio** (`add`); the shipped workflows do that, one of them for a video.

- `channels` = `mono`: the channel mean is separated, as the official usage does. `each channel`: every channel is separated on
  its own, which keeps stereo (twice the time for stereo).
- The models work on 44.1 kHz. Other rates are resampled with ComfyUI's own resampler; `output_sample_rate` = `44100` (the
  model's rate) or `input` (resampled back).
- The overlap-add windows of the model cards are used: DBS-TIGER 6 s every 3 s, DBS-BSRNN 3 s every 1.5 s. Any length works.
- The stems are in phase with the input and add back up to it (music + sfx + speech = input, to about 1e-6).
- Batches: every item is separated on its own.

candidates.readme_excerpt:
prompter
=======

[![Test Status](https://github.com/Songmu/prompter/workflows/test/badge.svg?branch=main)][actions]
[![Coverage Status](https://codecov.io/gh/Songmu/prompter/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)][codecov]
[![MIT License](http://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)][license]
[![GoDev](https://pkg.go.dev/badge/github.com/Songmu/prompter)][godev]

[actions]: https://github.com/Songmu/prompter/actions?workflow=test
[codecov]: https://codecov.io/gh/Songmu/prompter
[license]: https://github.com/Songmu/prompter/blob/main/LICENSE
[godev]: http://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Songmu/prompter

## Description

utility for easy prompting in Golang

## Synopsis

```go
twitterID := prompter.Prompt("Enter your twitter ID", "")
lang := prompter.Choose("Which language do you like the most?", []string{"Perl", "Golang", "Scala", "Ruby"}, "Perl")
passwd := prompter.Password("Enter your password")
var likeSushi bool = prompter.YN("Do you like sushi?", true)
var likeBeer bool = prompter.YesNo("Do you like beer?", false)
```

## Features

- Easy to use
- Prompts and validation messages go to stderr, keeping stdout clean
- Care non-interactive (not a tty) environment
  - `Default` is used and the process is not blocked
- No howeyc/gopass (which uses cgo) dependency
  - cross build friendly
- Customizable prompt setting by using `&prompter.Prompter{}` directly

## Read errors

Use `Prompter.PromptWithError()` to distinguish an answer from EOF or a read
error:

```go
answer, err := (&prompter.Prompter{
    Message: "Enter your name",
    Default: "guest",
}).PromptWithError()
if err != nil {
    return err
}
fmt.Println(answer)
```

An empty line uses `Default`, but EOF and read errors return an empty answer and
an error. `Prompt()` and the convenience functions instead report read errors to
stderr and return an empty answer (`false` for `YN` and `YesNo`).
Explicit default mode and non-interactive mode still return `Default` without
reading input.

## License

[MIT][license]

## Author

[Songmu](https://github.com/Songmu)

candidates.readme_excerpt:
# own-voice-stt

Record yourself for a while with a big speech model listening, and you end
up with a dataset of your own voice, your words and your microphone. Fine-tune
a small model on it and it can match the big one on *your* speech, at a
fraction of the size and latency.

This repository is a **recipe to read and adapt, not a product to install.**
It is meant to be read by you and your coding agent (start the agent on
[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)). The code is the code we ran, cleaned of anything
personal; it will need adjusting to your machine, your microphones, your
languages.

## What we got

One person, one laptop headset, ~2.5 months of an always-on recorder.
Teacher: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (627 M weights). Student: NVIDIA's
FastConformer hybrid *medium* streaming model (32 M weights), fine-tuned on
the teacher's transcripts of 12 h of the person's English speech.

Test set: 459 clips the person corrected by hand (never trained on). Word
error rate, 95% bootstrap intervals over clips:

| | weights | WER, all | WER, commands | exactly right |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Parakeet 0.6B v3 (the teacher, as it ran live) | 627 M | 11.0% (8.7–13.9) | 8.0% (6.1–10.0) | 80% |
| 32 M student, before fine-tuning | 32 M | 23.7% (21.0–26.6) | 20.8% (18.5–23.6) | 46% |
| **32 M student, fine-tuned** | 32 M | **11.1% (8.8–13.7)** | **7.7% (6.1–9.6)** | 76% |

Paired comparison (same clips): fine-tuned student minus teacher = +0.1
points (95% CI −1.9 to +2.0). A tie, at 1/20 of the weights.

Speed, time from the end of speech to the text:

| | where | wait after speech |
|---|---|---|
| Parakeet 0.6B | laptop CPU (i7-1065G7, 2019), 4 threads | ~1,060 ms |
| 32 M student, PyTorch | same laptop | ~150 ms |
| 32 M student, sherpa-onnx int8 (43 MB) | same laptop, 2 threads | ~85 ms |
| 32 M student | one RTX 3090 | ~50 ms |

Training: 37 minutes on one RTX 3090, 2.6 GB of GPU memory.

Then a second, tiny round: 90 prompted takes of the person's command words
(`ownvoice.prompt`), half held out, mixed at 3% into the full training set,
500 steps (2.5 min). Held-out command takes went from 88% to 93% exactly
right; the 459-clip test from 11.1% to 10.8% (no harm). Small numbers: 41
takes from one sitting.

### What this does *not* show (read before quoting the numbers)

- **The test set is mostly read commands on one headset.** 436 of the 459
  corrected clips were prompted phrases ("press …", "move …"), all through
  the same microphone. It is a good test of commands and a w

CRM

Comp AI CRM is an open source, CRM designed for AI agents.
Agentic-first CRM.

The agent · Stack · Quick start · Configuration · Deploying · Contributing

--- ## What this is Most CRMs are a database with a form in front of it. The AI ones bolt a chat box onto the side of that form. Both leave the actual work — finding out what is true, and writing it down — to a human who has better things to do. This is built the other way round. **The agent is not a feature of the CRM; the CRM is where the agent keeps its notes.** It runs on its own deployment, on its own schedule, against its own work queue. It decides what to look at next, books its own follow-ups, spends a research budget, and stops when the budget runs out. Nothing about it is request-response: close the browser and it keeps going. The rule the agent itself never breaks: **nothing about a person is guessed.** No tool accepts a confidence score, because a model asked to grade its own certainty will, and it will be wrong in the direction that makes it look useful. candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Free My TV **A fast, ad-free home screen for Google TV.** Trending picks from your own apps, the weather at a glance, and a look that follows the sunset.
Open source. Built with Claude Code. One button to undo. [**freemytv.io**](https://freemytv.io) · [Install](#install) · [Any TV](#any-tv) · [Make it yours](#make-it-yours)
## What you get - **No ads.** No sponsored rows, banners or autoplaying promos. Not one. - **Your apps, front and center.** The streaming apps you actually use, on a glass shelf. Pick them and their order right on the TV. - **Trending, not sponsored.** Three fresh picks every hour from what's trending this week and the latest releases, only from apps you already have. Movies and Shows get their own tabs. - **Weather and markets, one press away.** The hour-by-hour forecast, sunrise and sunset, and live crypto prices. - **Light by day, dark by night.** It follows your city's real sunset, the way your phone does. - **A screensaver to match.** Full-screen photos of the picks with a big glass clock. - **Fast.** 60 fps, every frame in 16.6 ms, on the TV's own chip. The home screen uses 96 MB of memory instead of 242 MB (−60%).
Measured on a 98″ TCL Google TV running Android 14. - **Set up on the TV.** Language, temperature, theme, the weather and prices cards, which coins, and the apps on the shelf, in Free My TV's own settings. - **Safe.** No root. Nothing is uninstalled. One button brings back the factory home screen. ## Install About ten minutes. You need a Google TV or Android TV (Android 12 or newer) and a computer on the same Wi-Fi. ### The easy way: Claude Code 1. **On the TV**, turn on developer mode: Settings → System → About → press *Android TV OS build* 7 times. Then Settings → System → Developer options → turn on **USB debugging**. Write down the TV's IP address (Settings → Network & Internet). 2. **On your computer**, get the code: ```bash git clone https://github.com/simbasjungles/free-my-tv && cd free-my-tv ``` 3. **Open [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) in that folder** and say: > Install Free My TV on my TV at 192.168.1.50. I live in Lisbon. It installs the tools it needs, builds the app and puts it on your TV. Swap in yo

My-neuro

English | 中文

## 本项目部署流程请看官网：[点我进官网](http://mynewbot.com/tutorials) my-neuro的目标是打造专属个人的 AI 角色,打造出逼近真人的AI伙伴 - 通过您的数据印记,塑造出心目中理想的 TA 的形象。 此项目受neuro sama启发，所以取名为my-neuro（社区提供的名称） 项目可训练声音、性格、替换形象 您的想象力有多丰富，模型就能多贴近您的期望。本项目更像是一个工作台。利用打包好的工具，一步步亲手描绘并实现心中理想的 AI 形象。 ### 计划清单 ### 双模型支持 - [x] 开源模型：支持开源模型微调，本地部署 - [x] 闭源模型：支持闭源模型接入 ### 核心功能 - [x] 超低延迟：全本地推理，对话延迟在1秒以下 - [x] 字幕和语音同步输出 - [x] 语音定制：支持男、女声、各种角色声线切换等 - [x] MCP支持：可使用MCP工具接入 - [x] 实时打断：支持语音、键盘打断AI说话 - [ ] 真实情感：模拟真人的情绪变化状态，有自己的情绪状态。 - [ ] 超吊的人机体验(类似真人交互设计，敬请期待) - [x] 动作表情：根据对话内容展示不同的表情与动作 - [x] 集成视觉能力，支持图像识别，并通过语言意图判断何时启动视觉功能 - [x] 声音模型（TTS）训练支持，默认使用gpt-sovits开源项目 - [x] 字幕显示中文。音频播放是外语。可自由开启关闭（适用于TTS模型本身就是外语的角色） ### 扩展功能 - [x] 桌面控制：支持语音控制打开软件等操作 - [x] AI唱歌（功能由： [@jonnytri53](https://github.com/jonnytri53) 资金赞助开发，特此感谢） - [ ] 国外直播平台的接入 - [x] 直播功能：可在哔哩哔哩平台直播 - [x] AI讲课：选择一个主题，让AI给你讲课。中途可提问。偏门课程可植入资料到数据库让AI理解 - [x] 替换各类live 2d模型 - [x] web网页界面支持（已做好，近期会接入） - [x] 打字对话：可键盘打字和AI交流 - [x] 主动对话：根据上下文主动发起对话。目前版本V1 - [x] 联网接入，实时搜索最新信息 - [x] 手机app应用：可在安卓手机上对话的肥牛 - [x] 播放音效库中的音效，由模型自己决定播放何种音效 - [x] 游戏陪玩，模型和用户共同游玩配合、双人、解密等游戏。目前实验游戏为：你画我猜、大富翁、galgame、我的世界等游戏（当前接入：我的世界、galgame） - [x] 长期记忆，让模型记住你的关键信息，你的个性，脾气 ### 模型自己想要的功能（待定考虑） - [ ] 变色功能：按照模型心情让屏幕变色妨碍用户 - [ ] 自由走动：模型自由在屏幕中移动 ### 项目流程图 ### 结尾画饼 我会把这几年的经验和对技术的理解都加入到此项目中。my neuro 这个名字除了蹭neuro sama的热度以外 更多的是我对AI边界的想象和期待 希望有一个真正的能懂你，理解你，且永远不会觉得无聊的AI陪伴在身旁。难受就一起难受，开心就一起开心。让影视作品、小说。幻想中的形象来到现实里 不仅仅是简单的聊天交互。希望它可以融入生活，成为一个有感情的个体。一起开黑玩游戏、看视频、学习东西、睡前聊天、叫你起床、工作时不说话看你发呆，会偷偷记住你做了什么。有情绪，有属于自己的情感状态。会真正的生气 每天都会有自己的情绪变化，会有自己想要做的事。会对某句话难受很久。某个词开心很久。会记住和你在一起经历过的每一个时刻。持续理解你的一个存在。 不过最重要的是，它的个性、样子、声音，情感变化等。都由你决定，就像橡皮泥，我们来提供最好的工具，做好每个模块适配。但最终是怎么样的，由自己来构造。 不过，对于不想折腾的朋友。此项目也直接打包了一个角色，就是肥牛（fake neuro）它是一个抄袭neuro sama的角色，但是个性我把它设定成了一个腹黑、傲娇、搞笑、有小脾气，但偶尔也会展现温柔一面的样子。 更希望的是从neuro 那里模仿借鉴，理解。然后尝试创造新的内容。适合自己的东西。 我对此项目特别的有热情。当前项目已经实现了将近
